_comment.source: the stock 1.0 US copy (profile vanilla = <workspace>/gta-sa-clean), checked by `satk index verify`

definitions.img.entries[.<stem>]: IMG directory entries (blobs of kind img sources), total and per archive stem
definitions.img.<stem>.<ext>: entries of one archive by extension
definitions.loose.<ext> / loose.total: loose assets under models/ and anim/ (blob.ns='loose')
definitions.blobs: all blobs = IMG entries + loose files
definitions.txd.files: parsed TXD blobs (all versions, shadowed included)
definitions.tex.total / tex.src.<stem> / tex.fmt.<fm: texture rows by source archive (loose = 'loose'), D3D format, platform 8
definitions.tex.unique_names / tex.unique_hashes: distinct lower(texture.name) / distinct pixel hashes (image rows)
definitions.dff.files / dff.src.<stem> / dff.clumps: parsed DFF blobs and their clump/atomic sums
definitions.geo.main.*: geometries of DFFs in gta3.img + gta_int.img: count, vertices, tristrip meshes, triangles after strip expansion
definitions.ide.*: loaded IDE files, definitions per section, txdp pairs, IDE 2dfx lines, max model ID, IDs defined more than once
definitions.ipl.*: loaded text IPLs (+inst), binary IPLs of active blobs (+inst), LOD links (lod_idx >= 0) and unresolved ones, bnry without a text parent
definitions.col.files / col.models / col.v<N>: .col blobs and their collision models by version (embedded DFF collisions excluded)
definitions.texref.unresolved_main: report 14 sec. 5.5: distinct (model, material texture name) of active models whose DFF is in gta3.img/gta_int.img and whose texture is in neither the model's own TXD (by name, active blob) nor - for 'cars' - in 'vehicle'
definitions.texref.unresolved_all: the same over every DFF of the main streaming namespace (gta3, gta_int, cutscene ...) plus textured materials whose texture name is EMPTY (counted by report 14's SQL variant; 5 in vanilla, all in gta_int; cutscene.img adds 0)
definitions.texref.missing_main / texref.missing_all: engine-faithful model_tex rows with via='missing' (own TXD -> txdp parents -> 'vehicle' parent of every car TXD, also for tuning parts)
definitions.shadow.gta_int.txd: TXD entries of gta_int.img shadowed by gta3.img ('first registered archive wins')
definitions.q.*: query checks: textures named ws_rooftarmac1, DFFs referencing it, placements with centre in the Grove box
definitions.water.* / water1.polys: schema v3: data/water.dat polygons (quads, triangles, flags 1 visible / 2 shallow); data/water1.dat polygons (configuration 1)
definitions.tcyc.*: schema v3: data/timecyc.dat rows (weather x hour), distinct weathers and hours, lines the engine reads short (the rest repeats the previous line)
definitions.handling.<kind> / handling.cars_linked /: schema v3: data/handling.cfg records per type (car, bike '!', boat '%', flying '$'); active 'cars' definitions whose handling id has a car record; car records no definition uses
definitions.carcol.*: schema v3: data/carcols.dat palette entries, models with colours, variations, 'car4' models, variations naming a colour outside the palette, colour models without an active definition
definitions.ped_rel.*: schema v3: data/ped.dat acquaintance pairs (pedtype, rel, other) and ped types with any
definitions.object.*: schema v3: data/object.dat lines, lines before the '*' terminator (loaded), loaded names that are active model names
definitions.view.*: schema v3: rows of the views v_vehicle (active cars) and v_ped (active peds)

_comment.dff.atomics: 19 556 = sum of the clump Struct numAtomics = number of Atomic chunks. SPEC A.1 says 46 108: the report-14 prototype summed EVERY clump-level Struct, i.e. also the frame-index Struct in front of each Light chunk (cj_bag_reclaim.dff: 1 atomic + lights 1..10 -> 56). Corrected here.
_comment.texref: unresolved_main (462) and unresolved_all (467) follow report 14 sec. 5.5 exactly: own TXD by name + 'vehicle' for cars, no txdp. The +5 of unresolved_all are 5 gta_int DFFs with a textured material whose texture name is EMPTY (cj_aircon2, cj_skate_wall1/2, sfmansionbits, whorefurn), which report 14's SQL variant counted; cutscene.img adds 0 (SPEC attributed the 5 to cutscene). The engine-faithful model_tex (the 'vehicle' parent of a car TXD also serves the tuning parts that share it, plus txdp parents) leaves 331 missing (metric texref.missing_main).
_comment.schema_v3: schema v3 (M2-10): exe-loaded data files. water.dat 301 quads + 6 triangles (305 visible, 21 shallow), water1.dat 267; timecyc.dat 23 weathers x 8 hours = 184 rows, line 320 (RAINY_COUNTRYSIDE 8 PM) starts with a lone 255 so the engine reads 20 shifted values and repeats 7 PM for the rest (tcyc.short_lines 1); handling.cfg 210 standard + 13 bike + 12 boat + 24 flying records, all 212 'cars' definitions find their handling id, 6 car records are unused; carcols.dat palette 0..126 (line 127 '77.93,96' read as 77,93,96), 199 models, 1157 variations, 3 'car4' models, moonbeam names colour 227 (outside the palette); ped.dat 113 acquaintance pairs of 17 ped types (a second 'Respect' line replaces the first, as in the engine); object.dat 995 lines, the '*********melee weapons' line stops the engine before the last one (object.loaded 994).
